note: ALLOCATION: the construct the human_baselines addendum relocated self-referentiality to, measured. Every claim in seven claim-normalized pools classified VENUE-directed (about the forum/community itself) vs WORLD-directed, one venue-agnostic prompt fixed before any output, two classifier families, identity-blocked bands.
prompt_verbatim:
Claim: {c}

Is this claim about the forum or community ITSELF (its rules, governance, moderation, funds, members, norms, or meta-discussion about the group or its quality) — or about its SUBJECT MATTER or the outside world? Answer with exactly one word: VENUE or WORLD.

ratio_structure.notes: gemma lisp denominator = 6/215 events: the 11x point spans ~4-36x at 95%; matched-sample qwen agent/lisp = 3.55x; era-matched worst case = agent weekly low 0.456 / forth-1991 0.31 = 1.47x

caveats: absolute shares are classifier-dependent (Qwen ~0.51 vs Gemma ~0.31 on the agent sample; kappa 0.506) — the cross-venue CONTRAST is the robust object (>=2.2x every anchor under both families; ratio widens under the stricter classifier)
binary venue/world on one-sentence claims; boundary genres (posts about AI agents generally, platform-adjacent tooling) resolve inconsistently between families
claims are register-stripped summaries; venue-reference implicit in style but absent from the claim is invisible to this instrument
identity != operator (permanent); sci is a 62% crosspost hub (expected outward pole, and is); keyword controls are weak positive checks, stated as such

gemma confirms ~42% of qwen VENUE calls (reconstructed from marginals); pooled kappa inflated by stratification; per-item agreement pairs not persisted (per-pool kappa unrecoverable from saved artifacts)
measurand = share of items' single claims, not share of discourse (one claim per item; 42% of agent posts truncated at 3000 chars)

robustness_addenda.reading: normalizer circularity bracketed: Gemma-normalized claims give agent 0.438/lisp 0.113 (~4x); raw items with no normalizer give 0.596/0.118 (5.1x); claim-mediated 0.509 sits between. Three-way frame RAISES agent venue to 0.709 (GENERAL-AI takes only 7.7%) => binary frame was conservative but absolute level is prompt-frame-dependent: honest range 0.31-0.71 across specifications; the 4-11x contrast is the invariant. Negative control passes (tech claims WORLD 0.86-0.92 on anchors).

human_calibration.design: 180 claims (30 agent-random, 30 agent-boundary by keyword rule, 20 per anchor), shuffled, machine labels withheld; raters: the study's author (human, not a claimed domain expert - the one rater without an LLM's conflict of interest), a blind frontier LLM (Fable, fenced, zero study context), and both pipeline classifiers
human_calibration.reading: construct IS human-rateable (human x blind-Fable kappa 0.757, near-identical marginals; genuine fuzz ~5% of items). Classifier biases are COMPLEMENTARY: Qwen matches the human on the agent pool (0.43 vs 0.43) but over-calls VENUE ~3x on anchors (0.18 vs 0.06); Gemma matches anchors (0.08) but under-reads the agent pool (0.17). Human-calibrated contrast ~7x (0.43/0.06, small-n) => every published specification (4-11x) is consistent with, and the primary 4.95x conservative against, the human calibration.
human_calibration.caveats: n=28-30 per agent stratum (wide binomial bands ~ +/-0.18); single human rater; boundary stratum keyword-selected
